svg.title: Trung Ng: AI compiler harnesses, MXFP and real-time inference
svg.desc: Illustrative hardware-software co-design. AI with a custom harness writes compiler passes and high-performance schedules. MXFP activations and weights carry a shared E8M0 scale per group of 32 elements into a systolic array, wide accumulation, and group requantization for real-time, low-latency inference. Not a cycle-accurate simulation.

g.text: ULTRA LOW LATENCY TPU · SCHEMATIC TIMING
